summary: Master digital marketing compliance and data privacy with practical tools, consent controls, and DPIA workflows. Enroll to improve governance today.
lede: Digital marketing privacy training covers how teams manage campaign data, consent, tracking, and customer communications. For marketing, compliance, privacy, analytics, and CRM professionals, it develops practical skills in mapping campaign data, assessing privacy risks, and governing consent, tracking, and martech vendors. Exercises include privacy-safe segmentation, handling rights requests and incidents, and creating a campaign data register, a Data Protection Impact Assessment, and a compliance action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who manage digital campaigns, customer data, privacy controls, and martech governance in operational environments. You may sit in marketing, compliance, legal, analytics, or privacy, but you need to work with real campaign data and real approval flows.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and basic familiarity with campaign workflows, consent notices, CRM records, or analytics dashboards. Familiarity with one martech environment, such as a web analytics platform, email system, or CRM, will help you complete the exercises more quickly.
